description: This file defines the SystemInfo class and related interfaces for system information retrieval, including environment variables, hardware details, and memory snapshots, within the Thunder::Core namespace.

classes.name: SystemInfo
classes.description: Provides system information such as hostname, memory, CPU load, environment variables, and system identifiers, with singleton access and memory snapshot capabilities.

classes.name: SystemInfo::MemorySnapshot
classes.description: Encapsulates a snapshot of system memory statistics, with JSON serialization.

classes.name: IService
classes.description: Interface for service objects within the system.

methods.name: Id
methods.description: Generates a device ID based on raw device data and a key.

methods.name: GetPhysicalPageCount
methods.description: Returns total number of physical pages.

methods.name: GetTotalSwap
methods.description: Returns total swap space in bytes.

methods.name: GetFreeSwap
methods.description: Returns free swap space in bytes.

methods.name: AsJSON
methods.description: Serializes memory snapshot to JSON string.
